Yes, both are pinned in `run3`. In `results/m1-210210-kcbump-2026-09-29/comparison.csv`, delta_dust is -0.987 [-0.997, -0.967] against a floor of -1, and E_bump is 5.86 [5.63, 5.96] against a ceiling of 6.

The data wanted a steeper slope and a stronger bump than that prior allowed, so the sampler ran into both walls. The "wide" run (slope U(-3, 0.4), bump U(0, 12)) confirms it. It gives delta -2.09 and E_bump 7.9 [5.1, 10.4], lnZ rises by about 32, photometric chi2 falls from 89 to 47, and the u* pull goes from -4.3 to +0.6.
